subject: The 3-minute mistake 90% of PupShape users make
preview_text: I discovered a tiny routine that makes this app 10x more effective. Most people skip it. Don't be one of them.
body_paragraphs: I almost didn't send this email. Because it reveals a simple truth: the most successful PupShape users aren't the ones who spend hours planning. They're the ones who do one tiny thing every single day. And if you skip it, you're leaving the most powerful part of this app untouched.

Here's the secret: consistency beats complexity every single time. The dogs losing 15% of their weight aren't on a perfect plan. Their owners just built a 3-minute daily habit. They open the app, log one thing, and close it. That tiny act of showing up creates a feedback loop that transforms worry into progress. It turns 'I should' into 'I am.' You stop being someone worried about their dog's weight and start being the person who is actively managing it.

This is why the daily weigh-in and food log feature is the engine of this whole thing. It's not just data entry. It's your 3-minute ritual. It connects the custom meal plan to real-world results. It turns the calorie calculator from a tool into a habit. And it makes the progress tracker come alive, because you're feeding it every single day.

Your action today: Open PupShape and log just ONE thing. Today's weight, or this morning's meal. Do it right now. It takes 3 minutes. That's the habit that builds the identity. P.S. The dogs with the best before/after photos? Their owners did this daily log for 21 days straight. Today is your day 21. Don't break the chain.
